name: deploying-to-cloud
title_zh: Laravel 应用一键上云，从部署到账单全接管
tagline_zh: 不用再翻 Laravel Cloud 文档。一个 CLI 管完部署、环境、数据库、队列、域名、定时任务和账单。
tagline_en: Stop hunting Laravel Cloud docs. One CLI handles deploys, envs, DBs, queues, domains, cron, and billing—even.
desc_en: Deploys and manages Laravel applications on Laravel Cloud using the `cloud` CLI. Use when the user wants to deploy an app, ship to cloud, create/manage applications, environments, databases, caches, object storage, queues, domains, instances, background processes, secrets, compute, scheduled tasks, check billing/usage/spend, or any Laravel Cloud infrastructure. Triggers on deploy, ship, cloud mana
why_zh: 把 Laravel Cloud 的分散操作收成一条命令流，环境差异和资源依赖自动处理。
why_en: Collapses Laravel Cloud's scattered ops into one command flow—env diffs and resource deps handled, then straight to usage, no.
limit_zh: 只认 Laravel Cloud 官方 CLI，不碰 AWS/GCP 自建服务器；只管理 cloud 上已有的应用。
limit_en: Laravel Cloud CLI only—no AWS/GCP self-hosting. Manages existing cloud apps, not code or local migration. Billing is read-only, no payments.
title_en: Ship Laravel to Cloud: deploy, scale, and bill in one CLI
